name: Red Leather Bandana
summary: In Westfall, the Red Leather Bandana marks those who defy Stormwind’s Crown. The Defias Brotherhood wears it to cover their faces and show their cause.

sections.title: Mark of the Brotherhood
sections.body: Across Westfall’s fields and abandoned farms, highwaymen, looters, and rebellious laborers wear crimson bandanas to hide their faces. The People's Militia at Sentinel Hill sees each as proof of loyalty to Edwin VanCleef's rogue fraternity. Scout Galiaan gathers the bandanas from travelers to follow the Brotherhood’s movements and dwindling numbers across the region.

faq.q: Why do the Defias wear red leather bandanas?
faq.answer: The Defias wear red bandanas to hide their faces while raiding farms and roads. They also show allegiance to Edwin VanCleef's uprising against Stormwind.

faq.q: Who wants these bandanas collected in Westfall?
faq.answer: Scout Galiaan of the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill asks travelers to gather the bandanas. He tracks the gang’s movements and confirms the deaths of roving bandits with them.
Defias rogues, highwaymen, and smugglers carry these bandanas at camps, in fields, and in mines across Westfall.

angles.text: For the Alliance, each red bandana taken from a fallen outlaw means one less brigand threatening Westfall’s starving farmers and beleaguered militia.
As a rogue, you know the crimson mask as a sign of underground banditry in human lands. Thieves organized with military precision wear it.
